title: Suspention Wrench
description: Just a Wrench from Create: Tracks
body:
This is a wrench from qwxon's Create: Tracks mod. All credit goes to qwxon, I just changed a model and changed some details + fixed some bugs.

Mod adds just a wrench (not tracks).
This mod is compatable with Bits 'n' Tracks (and Azimuth API).
